points.description: Valid conclusion from the data: plastic B stretched the most (about 22-23 mm) and plastic A the least (about 10-12 mm); order of stretchability B > D > C > A (or equivalent statement that B is most stretchable / A least stretchable), supported by the data.

levels.says: States only that plastics differ in stretchability, or identifies the most or least stretchable plastic without data support or ranking.

points.description: First improvement: a valid way to improve design/validity, e.g. more trials/repeats (and averaging), larger sample size, or more precise measuring tools.

Second, different improvement: e.g. control variables such as same starting length/width/thickness of samples, same mass of weights and same hanging time, measure the length before and after on the same sample, or use a more precise ruler/measuring method. Must differ from P2.

rubric.notes: Full marks: a data-supported conclusion (B most stretchable, A least) plus two distinct valid improvements. Part marks: vague conclusion earns half of P1. Equivalent wording accepted; the two improvements must be different ideas.
